components.why_8_4_body:
Without real data, sleep/social/circadian default to optimistic values (no late nights detected = high score). Typing and journal default to neutral 5.0. Result: weighted avg ≈ 7.8 → drifts to 8.4 with temporal smoothing.

Fix: Do your daily check-in → all signals update → accurate score.

signals.keystroke_desc: Measures your typing speed, backspace rate, and hesitation in chat/journal. Slow + high backspace = low mood signal.
signals.appUsage_desc: Tracks sleep quality from your check-in. Poor sleep → lower mood score.
signals.circadian_desc: Compares app usage time vs your baseline sleep time. Opening at 3 AM when you sleep at 11 PM = 3-point deduction.
signals.socialWithdrawal_desc: Measures social engagement from check-in. Not talking to anyone = withdrawal signal = lower score.
signals.journalSentiment_desc: Gemini AI analyzes emotional sentiment from your journal and chat. Most accurate when you write or chat.
